caption: The drawing depicts a single light-colored textile bonnet, shown in profile view with the front facing right. The bonnet features a softly gathered crown, suggesting a lightweight, flexible fabric, and is rendered primarily in shades of beige, light brown, and off-white. The edge of the bonnet is adorned with two vertical decorative bands composed of a trim embellished with repeating circular motifs and bordered by lace. The lace also follows the front edge of the bonnet, forming a delicate border. Two long, narrow fabric ties hang down from the lower edge, each ending in a small, matching lace trim. The background is plain and uncolored, highlighting the details and textures of the bonnet itself.
title: Economy Night Cap
